title: Expensive for what it is and watch the key while installing.
text:
Expensive for what it is and watch the key while installing.. I dont know why these parts are so expensive. Installed it for aunt and she was very happy.
The key came out and sheared the seal while I was installing it. To me it seems like the key should be welded and not just on there. It was not even pressed.
